claims.claim: Draft 0.5 is the current experimental repository authority for NEES execution and conformance intent.
claims.falsifier: A later accepted NEES authority supersedes Draft 0.5 or repository verification fails.
limitations: Repository authority is not external validation of performance methods.

claims.claim: Draft 0.5 provides a deterministic profile-bound cycle-ledger calculator whose repository fixture resolves to the expected result.
claims.falsifier: Repository verification fails, the fixture no longer resolves to its expected ledger, or the cost profile becomes internally inconsistent.
limitations: This validates calculator/profile composition, not the external accuracy of every cycle entry or the wall-clock performance of adopting code.

claims.claim: NEES conformance by itself proves a performance improvement.
claims.status: explicitly not a valid general inference
claims.falsifier: A conforming implementation with no measured enclosing-system improvement is sufficient to reject the inference.
limitations: Performance qualification is project-, workload-, hardware-, and causal-boundary-specific.
